facts.fact: 开场：Simone 以播报员身份预警，天气系统探测到一场雷暴正逼近岛上区域。
facts.anchor: This is your girl, Simone, with an important announcement. Our weather prediction system has picked up a possible thunderstorm closing in on the region.

facts.fact: 中段：正密切监测，一旦出现恶劣天气，所有户外区域将临时关闭。
facts.anchor: We’re monitoring it closely, and please be advised all outdoor areas will close temporarily if we do experience inclement weather.

facts.fact: 中段：劝慰深夜仍在游玩的客人，别让一点下雨的威胁扫了岛上兴致。
facts.anchor: If you’re still out there enjoying all the late-night action, don’t let the threat of a little rain dampen your island fun!

facts.fact: 中段：以戏谑口吻鼓励大家尽兴玩到筋疲力尽，再回鹅绒枕头上休息。
facts.anchor: Drive it like you stole it and then go rest your weary heads on your goose-down pillows when you finally tire yourselves out.

facts.fact: 结尾：继续以戏谑口吻鼓励客人冒雨尽兴，把假期玩个痛快。
facts.anchor: don’t let the threat of a little rain dampen your island fun! Drive it like you stole it
